biological_interpretation: THAP11/Ronin loss and THAP1 loss are not interchangeable THAP-domain perturbations: the atlas separates a strong THAP11/HCF1-Ogt-like mitochondrial/core-gene axis from a selective THAP1 Prepl module with only partial Ogt overlap.
caveats: Thap11 RNA was not detectably depleted by FDR in any cell type, so the strong recurrent downstream module is the primary engagement evidence.
The Thap1 self-transcript increase is compatible with autoregulation or persistence of mutant 3-prime transcripts and is not proof of intact THAP1 protein.
exact_observed_result: Thap11 produced a large cell-skewed core in 151 TH and 155 MB Glut with repeated decreases in Rabac1, Sdccag8, Gdap1, Mdh1, Ndufa3 and Mmachc and increases in Prkn and Ttc41. Thap1 instead produced a much smaller Prepl/Cuedc2/Fam117a module across thalamic, midbrain, hindbrain and Pvalb classes, and Thap1 RNA itself rose in the 151 TH class.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior work supports the broad molecular function of the perturbed target or complex, while the atlas result refines the affected brain cell type and RNA-output module.

resolved_evidence.description: Aggregate burden of significant Thap11 differential-expression calls across the 23 cell-type groups.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Thap11 produced 1543 FDR<0.05 gene-by-cell-type calls across 608 unique genes and 22/23 cell types. Top counts: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut 478, 155 MB Glut 210, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA 184, 191 MB P MY GABA 128, 052 Pvalb Gaba 104, 217 P MY Pineal Glut 85; 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut had 0.

resolved_evidence.description: The strongest Thap11 response occurred in the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class and contained the complete recurrent core module.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 297 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 478 FDR<0.05 genes; 20/20 recurrent core genes FDR<0.05. Examples: Rabac1 logFC -1.396 FDR 1.52e-52; Cdk5 -1.366 FDR 2.21e-50; Gdap1 -1.808 FDR 1.08e-48; Thoc6 2.520 FDR 1.40e-34; Prkn 1.024 FDR 1.95e-34; Ttc41 4.044 FDR 1.46e-28.

resolved_evidence.description: Midbrain glutamatergic neurons showed a very strong Thap11 core response.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 327 perturbed cells versus 20353 controls; 210 FDR<0.05 genes; 20/20 recurrent core genes FDR<0.05. Examples: Rabac1 logFC -1.695 FDR 2.39e-62; Sdccag8 -1.901 FDR 7.82e-49; Gdap1 -1.962 FDR 2.07e-46; Ndufa3 -1.583 FDR 4.22e-42; Ttc41 3.984 FDR 2.16e-27; Prkn 0.928 FDR 3.70e-27.

resolved_evidence.description: The pineal/hindbrain glutamatergic class showed the full core response despite a relatively small perturbed-cell count.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 64 perturbed cells versus 3465 controls; 85 FDR<0.05 genes; 20/20 recurrent core genes FDR<0.05. Sdccag8 logFC -2.444 FDR 5.08e-16; Rabac1 -1.891 FDR 2.40e-15; Acp6 -3.102 FDR 2.65e-13; Gdap1 -2.228 FDR 2.65e-13; Prkn 0.947 FDR 2.97e-7; Thoc6 2.142 FDR 2.04e-6.

resolved_evidence.description: Several cell types showed a weak or absent Thap11 downstream response, with the dopaminergic class also severely limited by cell number.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut had 107 perturbed cells, 0 FDR<0.05 genes, and 0/20 core genes significant; 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA had 102 perturbed cells and 1 FDR<0.05 gene; 215 MB Dopa had 25 perturbed cells and 1 FDR<0.05 gene.

resolved_evidence.description: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut had the largest FDR-significant Thap1 response.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 156 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; seven genes at FDR<0.05: Prepl logFC -0.336 FDR 3.79e-6; Cuedc2 -0.790 FDR 2.76e-5; Tomm40l 0.735 FDR 3.47e-5; Pet100 0.819 FDR 0.00433; Thap1 1.287 FDR 0.00573; Fam117a 3.229 FDR 0.00573; Cln3 -1.538 FDR 0.00573.

resolved_evidence.description: A compact Prepl/Cuedc2/Fam117a response was significant in midbrain glutamatergic neurons.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 136 perturbed cells versus 20,353 controls; Prepl logFC -0.411 FDR 6.49e-5; Cuedc2 -0.806 FDR 0.00226; Fam117a 2.468 FDR 0.0204.

resolved_evidence.description: A directionally matched Prepl/Cuedc2/Fam117a response was significant in pontine/medullary GABAergic neurons.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 81 perturbed cells versus 10,309 controls; Fam117a logFC 3.113 FDR 1.73e-5; Prepl -0.525 FDR 2.43e-5; Cuedc2 -1.096 FDR 1.85e-4.

resolved_evidence.description: Pvalb interneurons showed a two-gene FDR response with Prepl down and only nominal evidence for part of the recurrent Fam117a arm.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 101 perturbed cells versus 13,710 controls; Lyrm1 logFC 1.031 FDR 0.00733; Prepl -0.362 FDR 0.0108; Fam117a was nominally up with logFC 3.151, p=3.96e-5, FDR=0.166.

resolved_evidence.description: CNU-MGE GABA had a single FDR-significant Smyd2 response and weak nominal recurrence of the broader triad.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 58 perturbed cells versus 7,679 controls; Smyd2 logFC 0.724, score 4.744, p=2.09e-6, FDR=0.0356. Fam117a and Cuedc2 were nominal only: Fam117a logFC 2.595 p=5.79e-4 FDR=1.0; Cuedc2 logFC -0.629 p=0.00278 FDR=1.0.

resolved_evidence.description: The same three genes recurred with conserved directions more often than any other top Thap1-responsive genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Across 23 classes, Prepl was down at FDR<0.05 in 4 classes and at p<0.005 in 8 classes; Cuedc2 was down at FDR<0.05 in 3 classes and at p<0.005 in 11 classes; Fam117a was up at FDR<0.05 in 3 classes and at p<0.005 in 9 classes.

resolved_evidence.description: An assayed THAP1 complex-associated perturbation reproduced the Prepl arm of the Thap1 response in two cell classes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: In Ogt perturbations, Prepl was down in the same two midbrain/pons classes as in Thap1: Ogt n=82 in 155 MB Glut, Prepl logFC -0.420 FDR 0.00311 versus Thap1 logFC -0.411 FDR 6.49e-5; Ogt n=48 in 191 MB P MY GABA, Prepl logFC -0.540 FDR 0.000525 versus Thap1 logFC -0.525 FDR 2.43e-5.

resolved_evidence.description: A restricted signature-neighbor scan placed the known THAP1-associated Ogt perturbation high but not first, and also exposed exploratory top scalar neighbors.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Among 2,038 perturbations measured at at least 12 of the 16 Thap1 FDR-significant gene-by-cell coordinates, the top Pearson neighbor was Yy1, r=0.847; Ogt ranked 16th, r=0.659; the strongest negative neighbor was Slc1a2, r=-0.835.

resolved_evidence.description: The target transcript itself accumulated significantly in the strongest Thap1-responsive class.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 156 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; Thap1 score 4.738, logFC 1.287, nominal p=2.15e-6, FDR=0.00573; this was the only Thap1 target-transcript row with FDR<0.05.

resolved_evidence.description: Outside 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, target-transcript engagement was nominal or unresolved after FDR correction.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 22/23 tested cell classes had Thap1 target-transcript FDR=1.0; target-transcript logFC was positive in all 23 classes with range 0.086-1.536 and median 0.808. The strongest non-FDR self row was 308 CB GABA: score 3.068, logFC 1.536, p=0.00216, FDR=1.0, n=43.
